### pc1.startup
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
# Kathara: interfacce gia attive, solo IPv4 e routing statico.
ip -4 address show dev eth0 | grep -Fq 'inet 10.14.1.11/24 ' || ip address add 10.14.1.11/24 dev eth0

ip route replace default via 10.14.1.1 dev eth0

# ARP statico limitato ai vicini sul medesimo dominio L2.
ip -4 neigh replace 10.14.1.1 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:01:01 nud permanent dev eth0
ip -4 neigh replace 10.14.1.12 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:01:03 nud permanent dev eth0
ip -4 neigh replace 10.14.1.13 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:01:04 nud permanent dev eth0
ip -4 neigh replace 10.14.1.14 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:01:05 nud permanent dev eth0

# Stabilizzazione del gateway (massimo 8 tentativi, mai fatale).
probe_attempt=0
while [ "$probe_attempt" -lt 8 ]; do
    if ping -n -I eth0 -c 1 -W 1 10.14.1.1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        break
    fi
    probe_attempt=$((probe_attempt + 1))
    [ "$probe_attempt" -lt 8 ] || break
    sleep 1
done

set -eu
# Kathara: interfacce gia attive, solo IPv4 e routing statico.
ip -4 address show dev eth0 | grep -Fq 'inet 10.14.6.11/24 ' || ip address add 10.14.6.11/24 dev eth0

ip route replace default via 10.14.6.1 dev eth0

# ARP statico limitato ai vicini sul medesimo dominio L2.
ip -4 neigh replace 10.14.6.1 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:06:01 nud permanent dev eth0
ip -4 neigh replace 10.14.6.12 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:06:03 nud permanent dev eth0
ip -4 neigh replace 10.14.6.13 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:06:04 nud permanent dev eth0

# Stabilizzazione del gateway (massimo 8 tentativi, mai fatale).
probe_attempt=0
while [ "$probe_attempt" -lt 8 ]; do
    if ping -n -I eth0 -c 1 -W 1 10.14.6.1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        break
    fi
    probe_attempt=$((probe_attempt + 1))
    [ "$probe_attempt" -lt 8 ] || break
    sleep 1
done

item.text:
Generated the DNS hierarchy without altering topology, IPs, or routes.

- Added 13 authoritative BIND zones on pc1–pc13, with all 12 requested delegations and glue records.
- Configured service, web, and MX/A records using the machines’ existing IP addresses.
- Configured pc14 as a recursive resolver rooted at pc1.
- Pointed pc16–pc20 to pc14 via `/etc/resolv.conf`.
- Updated assigned server startup scripts to install BIND if necessary and launch `named`.

Key configuration files are under the new `pcN/etc/bind/` directories, e.g. [root zone](pc1/etc/bind/db.root) and [recursive resolver config](pc14/etc/bind/named.conf). Static verification confirms 13 master zones, 12 delegation records, 14 DNS daemon launchers, and five client resolver configurations.
